description_en: Retrieves a list of public keys that match the specified criteria. This operation supports pagination
description_zh: 查询满足条件的公钥信息列表，支持分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun vs list-public-keys --key-name mykey --key-group g-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --key-type ssh --start-time 2021-09-21T16:00:00Z --end-time 2021-09-22T02:23:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPublicKeys

parameters.help_en: The name of the public key
parameters.name: key_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the public key group
parameters.name: key_group

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the list to query. The value starts from 1.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，取值1～100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the public key. Valid values:

adb: ADB key

ssh: SSH key
parameters.help_zh:
公钥的类型。可取值：

adb：ADB Key
ssh：SSH Key
parameters.name: key_type

parameters.help_en: A parameter for filtering by time range. The time must be in UTC and follow the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: A parameter for filtering by time range. The time must be in UTC and follow the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 时间区间筛选参数。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time
